reasoning_content: There's a stack overflow in TypeScript - probably due to circular references. Let me stash local changes first and then pull fresh.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== STASH & PULL ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git stash && git pull origin fix/esm-stable 2>&1 | tail -3")
print(stdout.read().decode())

print("\n=== BUILD ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -15")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
